name: Shiranui Kyou
source: The second of [url=/c14792]Kazama[/url]'s attendants, who always follows behind him. Compared to [url=/c168416]Amagiri[/url], his attitude toward Kazama is rather careless. Although he is not really of an age to be a high school student, he was forcibly made to accompany Kazama when he re-entered high school.
